queries:
WITH qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'
),
patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt,
    AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS avg_tat_difference
FROM patient_averages

WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN TAT - TAT2 END) AS upro_avg_difference,
        AVG(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN TAT - TAT2 END) AS ra_avg_difference
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING SUM(`U-PRO` = '-') > 0
       AND SUM(RA = '-') > 0
)
SELECT
    AVG(upro_avg_difference) AS avg_upro_difference,
    AVG(ra_avg_difference) AS avg_ra_difference
FROM per_patient

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(TAT) AS avg_tat,
        AVG(TAT2) AS avg_tat2,
        AVG(PT) AS avg_pt
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING SUM(TAT IS NOT NULL AND TAT2 IS NOT NULL) > 0
       AND COUNT(PT) > 0
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_tat - avg_tat2) AS avg_tat_difference,
    AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt
FROM patient_averages
